usage: 咕嚕肉 is used to refer specifically to the dish sweet and sour pork in Cantonese.
It is a noun, so it often acts as the subject or object in a sentence.
You can use 咕嚕肉 alone or with classifiers, for example, 一碟咕嚕肉 (one plate of sweet and sour pork).
It commonly appears in conversations when ordering food or talking about favorite dishes.
You can describe the taste or quality by adding adjectives before 咕嚕肉, like 好味嘅咕嚕肉 (delicious sweet and sour pork).
